resources.name: Quantum ESPRESSO (or other open-source plane-wave DFT code supporting PBE+U)

access.notes: Any open-source plane-wave DFT code that implements PBE+U can be used.

resources.name: Rébola et al. Phys. Rev. B 85, 155132 (2012) — CCO approximant structures

access.notes: Provides the atomic positions and structural model for the 5/3 and 3/2 approximant unit cells of CCO.

resources.notes: Crystal structure input for constructing the initial unit cells.

resources.name: PseudoDojo pseudopotentials (PBE) for Ti, Co, Ca, O

access.notes: Standard PBE pseudopotentials; any equivalent library is acceptable.

resources.notes: Needed for performing plane-wave DFT calculations.

resources.name: Materials Project / OQMD — formation energies of bulk competing phases

access.notes: Used to determine chemical potential bounds by computing stability of secondary phases (CaO, CoO, Co3O4, Ti oxides, CaTiO3, etc.).

resources.notes: Public databases of computed materials properties.
